_meta.name: Checkpoint, from a photo (SD 1.5 / SDXL / Pony / Illustrious)
_meta.description: Image-to-image: your source photo is resized to the chosen size, encoded, and reworked with the prompt. Strength 0.3-0.5 keeps the photo and changes style/details; 0.7-0.9 keeps only the rough composition.
notes: ComfyUI's classic img2img graph in API format: LoadImage -> ImageScale (to width x height, center crop) -> VAEEncode -> KSampler with denoise = {{DENOISE}} (the Strength slider).
Use the '⟷ match source' size chip to keep the photo's aspect ratio; otherwise it is center-cropped to the size you set.
Pony V6 checkpoints want CLIP skip 2: insert a CLIPSetLastLayer node as in txt2img_checkpoint_clipskip2.json.
For inpainting or ControlNet, export your own ComfyUI workflow (API) and tokenise it the same way; keep {{IMAGE}} on the LoadImage node and "mode": "img2img".
requires: ComfyUI/models/checkpoints/<any SD1.5, SDXL, Pony or Illustrious checkpoint>.safetensors

defaults.negative: lowres, bad anatomy, bad hands, text, error, missing fingers, extra digit, fewer digits, cropped, worst quality, low quality, jpeg artifacts, signature, watermark, blurry
